dataset_pins._comment: Spikes 1-3 read the actr-paper kit's committed artifacts (USS-SGD/MWOZ MiniLM embeddings + meta, USS raw dumps, PRISM raw) from the sibling checkout; src/lib/actr_data.py verifies its HEAD against this pin and refuses to run on drift. ToolBench raw data is fetched (gated behind --fetch-data) from the HuggingFace mirror at the pinned revision below; the preprocess logic is ported from the abandoned turn-encoding repo at the commit recorded here, with goal_text/goal_embedding added as first-class fields.
